policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Midwestern State outscore every other programme in the division Two matches into the season, Midwestern State have scored eleven goals and conceded one. The 28 other programmes across the Gulf South, the Great American and the Lone Star have all scored fewer, and no conference has yet opened its own play.
claims.note: held against every other programme; the nearest is uah at 8
